name: AWS Database Fleet Health (RDS / Aurora / Redshift)
description: Fleet-wide view of RDS, Aurora, and Redshift storage, IO, and health metrics streamed via CloudWatch Metric Streams. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID before import. Verify dimension names against your account using the coverage-check query pack before relying on FACET results.

pages.name: Fleet Overview
pages.description: At-a-glance worst-first view across all AWS database services.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT uniqueCount(aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier) WHERE metricName = 'aws.rds.CPUUtilization' SINCE 10 minutes ago
FROM Metric SELECT uniqueCount(aws.rds.dbClusterIdentifier) WHERE metricName = 'aws.rds.VolumeBytesUsed' SINCE 10 minutes ago
FROM Metric SELECT uniqueCount(aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier) WHERE metricName = 'aws.redshift.CPUUtilization' SINCE 10 minutes ago

widgets.title: RDS / Aurora -- Worst First (CPU, Free Storage, Disk Queue, Connections)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace)/1e9 AS 'Free GB' WHERE metricName = 'aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace' FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 10 minutes ago LIMIT 1

widgets.title: RDS + Aurora Instances -- Sorted Worst First

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT latest(aws.rds.CPUUtilization) AS 'CPU %', latest(aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace)/1e9 AS 'Free Storage GB', latest(aws.rds.DiskQueueDepth) AS 'Disk Queue Depth', latest(aws.rds.DatabaseConnections) AS 'Connections' FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 10 minutes ago LIMIT 100

FROM Metric SELECT latest(aws.redshift.CPUUtilization) AS 'CPU %', latest(aws.redshift.PercentageDiskSpaceUsed) AS 'Disk Used %', latest(aws.redshift.WLMQueueLength) AS 'WLM Queue Length', latest(aws.redshift.DatabaseConnections) AS 'Connections' FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 10 minutes ago LIMIT 100

pages.name: RDS
pages.description: Storage, IO, and health for standard RDS instances (MySQL, Postgres, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle).

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.FreeStorageSpace)/1e9 AS 'Free GB' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Burst Balance (gp2 storage -- early IO throttle warning)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.BurstBalance) AS '% Burst Balance' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 3 days ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.ReadIOPS) AS 'Read IOPS', average(aws.rds.WriteIOPS) AS 'Write IOPS' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.DiskQueueDepth) TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.ReadLatency)*1000 AS 'Read ms', average(aws.rds.WriteLatency)*1000 AS 'Write ms' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.CPUUtilization) AS 'CPU %', average(aws.rds.FreeableMemory)/1e9 AS 'Freeable Mem GB', average(aws.rds.SwapUsage)/1e6 AS 'Swap MB' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.DatabaseConnections) TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

pages.name: Aurora
pages.description: Aurora-specific storage and replication metrics (MySQL-compatible and Postgres-compatible).

widgets.title: Volume Bytes Used Over Time (GB) -- Aurora's real 'getting full' metric

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.VolumeBytesUsed)/1e9 AS 'Volume GB' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbClusterIdentifier SINCE 7 days ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.AuroraReplicaLag) TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Volume Read / Write IOPs (billing + performance signal)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.VolumeReadIOPs) AS 'Read IOPs', average(aws.rds.VolumeWriteIOPs) AS 'Write IOPs' TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbClusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Serverless Capacity Units (Aurora Serverless v2 only)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.ServerlessDatabaseCapacity) TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.rds.EngineUptime) TIMESERIES FACET aws.rds.dbInstanceIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

pages.name: Redshift
pages.description: Redshift cluster health, disk usage, and workload management queue metrics.

widgets.title: Percentage Disk Space Used -- Redshift's 'getting full' metric

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.redshift.PercentageDiskSpaceUsed) TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 7 days ago
FROM Metric SELECT latest(aws.redshift.HealthStatus) TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: WLM Queue Length / Duration -- classic Redshift trouble signal

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.redshift.WLMQueueLength) AS 'Queue Length', average(aws.redshift.WLMQueryDuration)/1000 AS 'Query Duration (s)' TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.redshift.ReadIOPS) AS 'Read IOPS', average(aws.redshift.WriteIOPS) AS 'Write IOPS' TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.redshift.CPUUtilization) TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago

FROM Metric SELECT average(aws.redshift.DatabaseConnections) AS 'Connections', average(aws.redshift.ConcurrencyScalingActiveClusters) AS 'Concurrency Scaling Clusters' TIMESERIES FACET aws.redshift.clusterIdentifier SINCE 1 day ago
